services.name: Interface + DI registration
services.rule: New application services expose I* interface; register in ApplicationHost (or feature extension). Do not new() services inside other services (Stripe SDK exception).

services.name: Singleton hosted service + EF scope
services.rule: Singletons must use IServiceScopeFactory.CreateScope() before resolving AppDbContext / IDbContextFactory. Never resolve scoped DbContext from root provider.

services.name: Fiscal payment facade naming
services.rule: PosPaymentService does not exist. Fiscal POS payments = IPaymentService/PaymentService. Card gateway = ICardPaymentService. Online orders = IOnlineOrderPaymentService.

services.name: Idempotent cancel/refund
services.rule: CancelPaymentAsync / RefundPaymentAsync accept optional idempotencyKey; same key must not create duplicate BelegNr/stock movements.

controllers.name: Admin controller boundary
controllers.rule: Admin APIs use Route("api/admin/...") + [Authorize] + [HasPermission(...)] or Roles.SuperAdmin. Return DTOs; cross-tenant missing resources → 404.

controllers.name: SuperAdmin tenant CRUD
controllers.rule: Tenant SaaS CRUD is SuperAdmin-only on /api/admin/tenants. tenants table is global; Impersonate issues JWT with target tenant_id.

controllers.name: POS controller boundary
controllers.rule: POS clients only call /api/pos/*, /api/Auth/*, /api/Receipts/* (and documented shared). Never add POS features under /api/admin/*.

controllers.name: Permission-first + audit mutations
controllers.rule: Admin user mutations: permission-first (users.manage / user.manage), audit every mutation, soft-delete (no hard delete of users).

controllers.name: Admin TSE ops controllers
controllers.rule: Diagnostic TSE ops under /api/admin/tse/* require system.critical; thin controllers delegate to Services/Tse. Not DEP rewrite.

components.name: FA feature folder layout
components.rule: frontend-admin/src/features/{domain}/ holds components/, hooks/, api/, utils/, types/. Pages under app/(protected)/ compose features. Prefer Orval generated hooks for admin API.

components.name: Ant Design 6 feedback
components.rule: Never static message/notification/Modal.confirm from antd. Use useNotify() for toasts; useAntdApp().modal for confirms.

components.name: Orval + TanStack Query
components.rule: Server data via TanStack Query (Orval hooks or feature api wrappers). Do not mirror API payloads in Zustand. Auth stays in AuthProvider + authStorage.

components.name: TenantProvider composition
components.rule: Tenant identity from JWT + Dev switcher + getCurrentTenant API. resolveEffectiveTenant merges override/API/current state.

components.name: Admin i18n strings
components.rule: No hardcoded user-facing strings in FA; use useI18n() namespaces under frontend-admin/src/i18n/. POS UI remains German hardcoded/locale files separately.
